works.body:
こんにちは！海外から来たVTuberです。他のクライアントを通してあなたのアートを見つけ、とてもかわいいと思いました！同じような構図の絵をお願いしたいのですが、ピンクのモチーフでお願いします。
ハートのポーズもお願いします！
お忙しい中ありがとうございました🩷

https://fxtwitter.com/leblanclunatan/status/1863279931104342023

https://x.com/leblanclunatan/status/1863279931104342023

ふぐさん、こんにちは！
早速ですが、私のOC（天使ちゃん）のイラストをリクエストさせてください。ふぐさんのデフォルメの効いた絵柄が大好きなので、ふぐさんの絵柄で描かれた天使ちゃんをぜひ見てみたいです。

設定としては、記憶を失った後の姿がメインですが、描きやすい方で大丈夫です。見た目の年齢は10代の少女ですが、天使なので大人びて見えたり、子供っぽく見えたりもします。自由に描いていただけたら嬉しいです！
よろしくお願いしますm(_ _)m

https://x.com/tab_888/status/1867473552687214802?s=46&t=dbt99X6Xv47TZbyxOhYWTQ

お世話になります。
山麓さんの絵柄でうちの子のレッカとパトを見てみたいです。

URLのポストのツリーを参照の上、ご自由に解釈していただいて、諸々おまかせで描いていただきたいです。

もしよろしければお願いいたします。

https://x.com/yunikisaha41800/status/1538550754939572225?

こんにちは。いつもふぐさんのイラスト楽しみに拝見させていただいております。
1年ほど前に自分の私服を着せる企画で描かれていたW13-63さんがとても好きで、彼（彼女）の正装姿も見てみたくリクエストを送らせていただきました。
構図やポーズなどはお任せします。よろしくお願いします！（簡潔ですみません）

Hello Mr. Sanroku Fugu Sensei.
I love the sparkling and attractive personification of F1 cars that you draw.
I have requested this because I wanted to see a child again, which I have less chance to see since the season has changed.

[Details of request
The character is W12 car 77 and the clothes can be either the last race or normal.

I would like to see her in any pose, facial expression, situation, composition, etc. I would like her to be drawn as she pleases. I would like you to draw the character as you like.

Usage.
For personal use only.

Thank you for always showing us your wonderful illustrations. I will continue to support you.
You can kick this request if it is annoying 🙇.

Thank you for your help.
We would like you to draw our child, a Kihani 5000 anthropomorphic character.

The reference for the appearance is as shown in the URL, but I don't have a very detailed setting because I have not drawn much myself recently.

I think it is difficult to understand from the reference material, so I would like to add that the clothes have the texture of work clothes, and the color in the setting is brown (so-called grape color No. 1), which is very close to black. The shirt is drawn with a design similar to that of the boarding doors of the actual car, but I don't know if it is uneven or printed. ......
The hair color is grayish rather than silver.
I would appreciate it if you could make up or cover up the details as you see fit!

The drawing of her body is not stable enough, so it is hard to tell, but please give her a childish look. (It would be better if it has the atmosphere that Mr. Sanroku usually draws.)

I would like her to have a childlike personality, but she may smile, so any kind of facial expression is fine.

I can leave the pose and composition up to you!　I would like to see the atmosphere you draw!　If it is OK with you, I would be grateful for your cooperation!
